title: Momoi Airi — Happy Birthday!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: The day before Airi's birthday
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, looks like tomorrow's birthday stream's all set to go!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm really looking forward to your birthday stream.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Me too! Especially since it means we get to celebrate your birthday with all our fans, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I'm also excited.
Oh, speaking of celebrations...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Isn't it about time you headed back to class, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We don't have school tomorrow, remember? So, everyone brought their birthday presents for you today.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, you're right! Airi, we need to hurry!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, let's go! I'm sure they're all waiting for you!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Why are you two getting so worked up?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Still, Haruka's right.
Let's go.
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Airi, look!
They're all lined up outside of your class!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh wow. I wasn't expecting anything like this to happen...

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line:
A-Airi... I mean, Momoi!
Th-Th-This is for you! Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line: This is for you too! W-Would you be willing to accept...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Thanks!
Of course I accept!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sorry for making you all wait like this. It's been getting a little warmer lately, but wasn't it cold out in the corridor?

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line: No, since we know you practice every morning! A-Also, I was so excited that the cold didn't bother me at all!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Really? Hang on... Yeah, your hands are freezing. Be careful not to catch a cold or anything, okay?

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line:
W-We're shaking hands...!!
Thank you for being so thoughtful!
I absolutely promise not to get sick!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. That's the spirit.
But make sure to warm back up when you get back to class.

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line: I will! Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line:
H-Happy birthday, Airi!
I wasn't able to make it to any of your events or meet and greets, but I've been a fan of yours since you were in QT!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
You've been a fan that long...?
Alright, here's a little reward!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Lovely☆ Fairy☆ Airi... Momoi!!

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line:
Th-The Airi pose!!
In-person too...! Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, Saki.
Are you here to give Airi a present too?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yes! As her fan, I felt that I absolutely need to celebrate her birthday!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Me too♪ Especially since Airi helped us out so much for Valentine's Day☆

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hey, Saki, Emu!
Thanks for coming!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
It's our pleasure!
At the very least, you've given me so much hope that I want to give back somehow!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe☆ I've prepared a song that's guaranteed to put a smile on your face, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You have?! Does this mean you're gonna sing it for me right here?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Of course!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I present you...
“The Invincible Smiling Idol☆”...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Airi seems so happy.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Especially since...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Airi hardly ever talks about her own past, so it's easy for us to believe that she isn't bothered by it anymore. But I guess it still does in some small ways...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: When she was on all those variety shows, losing her identity as a proper idol just kept weighing down on her.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But some time ago, when she was about to change agencies...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: She told me that she feels like she hasn't been able to deliver anything to anyone as an idol.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I tried to cheer her up by saying that's not true, but it didn't help much in the end...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (She's been working so hard to be that idol who can spread and inspire hope in others.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh!
The Masked Variety Idol will always be there to help those who try their very best!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Whenever you feel down and out, come and see me! I'll help cheer you up and see how wonderful tomorrow is going to be!

rows.Speaker: Shy Girl
rows.Line:
Okay!
Thanks, Happy Everyday!

rows.Speaker: Shy Girl
rows.Line: Oh, also...

rows.Speaker: Shy Girl
rows.Line: I really like you as an idol too! You're the best, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'll go put all the presents you've received on your desk, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You will? Thanks, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (They all love you just this much, Airi.)
Airi's Room

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, more kitty goods!
Hehe. I guess they all know that I have a soft spot for cats!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (They must've spent a lot of time wondering, “What would she like the most?”)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (It's gonna take some time, but I should start writing thank you cards for everyone.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh? A message from Ena...? Mizuki too?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Happy birthday, Airi!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Mizuki and I were talking on Nightcord, and decided to send you messages just as the clock struck midnight. Sorry if we woke you up.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Hehe. That reminds me of how she used to do this for me in junior high whenever my birthday rolled around.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Let's see what Mizuki said...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Happy birthday, Airi!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Ena got all worked up about celebrating your birthday sooner than anyone else and I decided to join the fun♪>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <We tried sending them on the count of three, but I'm wondering if Ena didn't jump the gun.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. Oh, those two.
Anyway, I'll reply to Ena first...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
<All good. I'm still up.
This reminds me of when you did this for me when we were in junior high.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Also...
